title: Find academic literature that explores the use of artificial intelligence in the design process, including generative design, AI-assisted decision-making, optimisation, and human-AI collaboration in design workflows. Focus on conceptual frameworks and applied examples in product design or engineering design. Exclude studies focused exclusively on medical diagnostics or clinical AI systems unrelated to design processes. Prioritise recent literature (last 5–7 years) and review papers.
